_readme: Deployment profiles for NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin. Each profile pins the exact JetPack/L4T/CUDA/cuDNN/TensorRT/Python/Docker-base combination a working deployment was BUILT AND VERIFIED against on real hardware. When a new JetPack ships, add a NEW profile entry here (never edit an existing one's version numbers) and re-run scripts/verify_jetson_agx_gpu.py + scripts/deploy_jetson_agx.sh on the real device to fill it in and flip verified to true. Never mark a profile verified from documentation alone -- only from a real run's output. The l4t_major/cuda_major/cuda_minor/cudnn_major/tensorrt_major/tensorrt_minor/python_abi/arch fields are what scripts/jetson_common.py's profile_matches() actually compares against the live-detected environment -- ALL of them must be non-null and exactly equal for a profile to match; the human-readable jetpack/l4t/cuda/cudnn/tensorrt/python strings are for people reading this file, not for matching logic. ort_candidate_id is the GATE linking a verified profile to config/jetson_ort_candidates.json: scripts/install_jetson_ort.py NEVER selects an ORT candidate by matching environment fields against candidates directly -- it first requires an exact-matching profile here with verified=true, then looks up THAT profile's ort_candidate_id in the candidates file. A verified profile with a null or unresolvable ort_candidate_id still falls back to CPU (a verified profile only proves the JETSON ENVIRONMENT was confirmed on real hardware -- it does not by itself supply a working ORT wheel).

profiles.onnxruntime_source: Jetson-specific ARM64 GPU build (e.g. from the Jetson Zoo or NVIDIA's own ORT wheel for the matching JetPack) -- never a generic x86 PyPI wheel
profiles.notes: Placeholder. Populate every null field from scripts/verify_jetson_agx_gpu.py's and scripts/detect_jetson_env.py's actual output on the target device -- do not fill in guessed version numbers.

selection_policy: If the device's detected environment does not EXACTLY match (via scripts/jetson_common.profile_matches -- every one of l4t_major/cuda_major/cuda_minor/cudnn_major/tensorrt_major/tensorrt_minor/python_abi/arch must agree) any profile with verified=true, deploy_jetson_agx.sh must refuse to install a GPU wheel and instead run in CPU Safe Mode (CPUExecutionProvider only). Even a verified match with no resolvable ort_candidate_id still falls back to CPU. This file ships with zero verified profiles because no run against real AGX Orin hardware has happened from this development environment.
